liz: Noticing weird SSE parse errors in the onboarding sample app when token refresh happens mid-stream. Anyone else?

sam: Node or browser? sdk version?

liz: Node 18, sampleapp 0.3.5, js-sdk 1.5.0. Short-lived token (30s). Client refreshes and reconnects; sometimes messages arrive with broken delimiters or reordered fragments.

liz: Example raw stream:```\ndata: {\"id\":1,\"text\":\"a\"}\\n\\n:data: keepalive\\ndata: {\"id\":2,\"text\":\"b\"}\\n\\n```

liz: The ":data:" keepalive merged with the next frame on reconnect and produced ":data: keepalive\ndata:" which the parser treats oddly.

anil: Looks like leftover bytes from old socket reassembled with new one. Two mitigations: require full `\\n\\n` before emitting, and set Last-Event-ID on reconnect so server can resume cleanly.

sam: Also guard against parallel reconnects during token refresh; serialize retries with a small backoff. We had a similar bug in the mobile sampleapp.

liz: I'll update sampleapp to 1) buffer until terminal delimiter, 2) ignore lone ":" comment lines, 3) include Last-Event-ID on socket reconnects.

devx-bot: Created issue #2417 sse-auth-reconnect-stitching labels: devex, streaming, priority-high.
